On Thu, May 21, 2015 at 10:57 AM, DrunkenPhD <end...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I am trying to recreate this example:

https://github.com/Arevaju/shiny-maps/blob/master/server.R

for my own geojson file. My server.R file is below:

server.R
##########

library(shiny)
library(rCharts)
library(rMaps)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$myplot<- renderChart2({
      d1 <-  ichoropleth(
        Population ~ Prefecture, 
        labels = TRUE,   
        data = info1,
        pal = input$pal,
        ncuts = input$ncuts,
        legend = TRUE,
        #       animate = 'year',
        #       play = TRUE,
      )
      d1$set(  
        geographyConfig = list(
          dataUrl = "https://www.dropbox.com/s/4cvtvl4pbfiakgq/qarku.geojson?dl=0",
          highlightFillColor = 'orange',
          highlightBorderColor = 'white',
          highlightBorderWidth = 1.5,
          popupOnHover = TRUE,
          popupTemplate = "#! function(geography, data){
          return '<div class=hoverinfo>' + geography.properties.name + 
          ': ' + data.Population+ '</div>';
    } !#"        
        ),
        scope = 'nuts2wgs2',
        height = 1050,
        legend = TRUE,
        setProjection = '#! function( element, options ) {
        var projection, path;
        projection = d3.geo.mercator()  
        .scale(480)
        .center([20.171558, 41.258292])
        path = d3.geo.path().projection( projection );
        return {path: path, projection: projection};
  } !#'
      )
      d1
  })       
  }
)

Nothing is shown beside widgets as shown in UI.R. I even recreated dataset info1 with the same fields. What is wrong?
Please help
Regards
